title: Check funded intermediate-chart splits of the BIT word
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Under the original clocks and chart incidence, 1,497 transfers have no live identical field at a strict intermediate chart. The exact XOR extension tests all 1,271 eligible live-stock cases for 162 grade-four through grade-six transfers. A literal grade-five split into grade three and grade two fully reproduces both native maps, with complete BIT margin −0.4954803621 at 0.00388.

## Task and overlap

This is a refined follow-up to [#7852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7852) at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Uses the native baseline and earlier stock-cut machinery [#7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830) at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`, [#7985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7985) at `251e15df3e0c058a843e7cb13f5882179a4e3afc`. The test grants any live productive or public field in the original intermediate stock.

## Validation

Extract in a clean Python 3.12 directory, run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and the README commands. The cold replay checked both inventories, both native orientations and complete paired-caller bins. A previously paid live receipt carrying the wrong value damaged 64 forward and three adjoint rows.

## Open next questions

Test a changed producer, a newly justified productive return, a different intermediate chart or an exact retiming with its full signed cost.

## Credit

Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the original caller, supplier and verifier authors identified in the source notices.
